article.title: Attachment in case of decree for rent or mesne profits or other matter, amount of which to be subsequently determined.
article.content: Where a decree directs an inquiry as to rent or mesne profits or any other matter, the property of the judgment-debtor may, before the amount due from him has been ascertained, be attached, as in the case of an ordinary decree for the payment of money.
article.html:
42Attachment in case of decree for rent or mesne profits or other matter, amount of which to be subsequently determined.

Order 21, Rule 42

Where a decree directs an inquiry as to rent or mesne profits or any other matter, the property of the judgment-debtor may, before the amount due from him has been ascertained, be attached, as in the case of an ordinary decree for the payment of money.
